purpose: Make each multi-system batch compose an observation-independent field child with zero or one separately content-addressed observation-evaluation child, so changed masks, beams, uncertainties, or measured arrays reuse the same gravity solution.

fieldPhase: one field child is created or reused for every batch system
field child identity contains the frozen model, source bundle, solver controls, requested field observables, and worker hash
field child request contains no observation targets or measured observation arrays
observationPhase: a succeeded field child with declared observation targets creates or reuses one observation-evaluation child
a system without observation targets creates no observation child
a failed, cancelled, or nonconverged field child creates no observation child
the observation child independently binds the source field identity, target declarations, observation bundle, and evaluation worker hash
reporting: child_jobs.json and per_galaxy.csv retain both field and observation child identifiers
field and observation scientific hashes remain separate
aggregate scores come only from successful observation children
field failures and observation failures are classified separately
the deterministic manifest records both worker source hashes and the composed execution scope

claimBoundary: P0733 changes orchestration and provenance, not a gravity equation or an observation mapping.
A shared field identity demonstrates reuse only when model, source mass distribution, grid, boundaries, solver controls, and requested field observables are unchanged.
Massive-tracer and photon mappings remain separately typed; P0733 does not add photon lensing.
The local reference queue remains single-user and filesystem-backed; durable public execution is a later infrastructure milestone.
